description: Guided help for understanding, running, troubleshooting, and contributing to the open-source Overleaf collaborative LaTeX editor.

defaultPrompt: Help me understand the Overleaf repository and identify the relevant files for my task.
Troubleshoot my local Overleaf Community Edition or Docker setup using evidence from logs and documentation.
Help me prepare a small, well-tested contribution to the Overleaf open-source project.
interface.longDescription: Helps you navigate the Overleaf open-source repository, understand its architecture, troubleshoot local Community Edition deployments, work with LaTeX projects, and prepare focused open-source contributions. It provides repository-grounded guidance and does not claim to control a live Overleaf account.

name: overleaf-helper
